description:
Ganyu ( Chinese : 甘雨 Gānyǔ ) is a playable Cryo character in Genshin Impact .

She is a half- qilin adeptus under contract with the Geo Archon Morax and serves as the general secretary of the Liyue Qixing . Due to her adeptal background, she finds herself feeling separated from the human world.
role_summary: Ganyu ( Chinese : 甘雨 Gānyǔ ) is a playable Cryo character in Genshin Impact .

talents.name: Liutian Archery
talents.description: Normal Attack Performs up to 6 consecutive shots with a bow. Charged Attack Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG. While aiming, an icy aura will accumulate on the arrowhead before the arrow is fired. Has different effects based on how long the energy has been charged: Charge

talents.name: Trail of the Qilin
talents.description: Leaving a single Ice Lotus behind, Ganyu dashes backward, shunning all impurity and dealing AoE Cryo DMG . Ice Lotus Continuously taunts surrounding opponents, attracting them to attack it. Endurance scales based on Ganyu's Max HP. Blooms profusely when destroyed or once its duration ends, dealing AoE Cryo DMG .

talents.name: Celestial Shower
talents.description: Coalesces atmospheric frost and snow to summon a Sacred Cryo Pearl that exorcises evil. During its ability duration, the Sacred Cryo Pearl will continuously rain down shards of ice, striking opponents within an AoE and dealing Cryo DMG .

talents.name: Undivided Heart
talents.description: After firing a Frostflake Arrow , the CRIT Rate of subsequent Frostflake Arrows and their resulting bloom effects is increased by 20% for 5s.

talents.name: Harmony between Heaven and Earth
talents.description: Celestial Shower grants a 20% Cryo DMG Bonus to active members in the AoE .

talents.name: Preserved for the Hunt
talents.description: Refunds 15% of the ore used when crafting Bow -type weapons.

c2.name: The Auspicious
c2.effect: Description Preview Trail of the Qilin gains 1 additional charge . Hover over previews to view in higher quality. ( Preview Preferences ) Media:Constellation The Auspicious.mp4

c3.name: Cloud-Strider
c3.effect: Increases the Level of Celestial Shower by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Westward Sojourn
c4.effect: Opponents standing within the AoE of Celestial Shower take increased DMG. This effect strengthens over time. Increased DMG taken begins at 5% and increases by 5% every 3s, up to a maximum of 25%. The effect lingers for 3s after the opponent leaves the AoE.

c5.name: The Merciful
c5.effect: Increases the Level of Trail of the Qilin by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: The Clement
c6.effect: Description Gameplay Notes Preview Using Trail of the Qilin causes the next Frostflake Arrow shot within 30s to not require charging. When this effect is ready, it will be indicated by a glowing star on Ganyu's left wrist. Hover over previews to view in higher quality.
